object.attr: derived: agents choose tools and values from the descriptions, so a description is part of the interface. One that disagrees, like `inspect_object`'s `trace_depth` against `trace`'s `max_depth`, leads an agent to a wrong call (Q-M13; TRACE review). Decided on 2026-11-10. Verified by inspection.
object.description: The description that the MCP server gives each tool shall agree with the requirements that specify the tool and the tool's parameters.
